name: Intercontinental transport of cryopreserved GMP mesenchymal stem cell vials in an LN2-vapour dry shipper (< -150 C, must stay below -130 C, transits up to 178 h)
plain_name: Ship frozen cell-therapy vials between countries in a nitrogen dry shipper
description: Clinical-trial supply chain: GMP fetal-liver MSC vials stored at -150 C are shipped from Sweden to India by courier in a vapour-phase LN2 dry shipper with a data logger; temperature had to stay below -130 C; transits took 56 h to 178 h, arrival temperatures -193/-194 C.
keywords: Ship frozen cell-therapy vials between countries in a nitrogen dry shipper

sources.citation: Kumar A et al. Successful transport across continents of GMP-manufactured and cryopreserved culture-expanded human fetal liver-derived mesenchymal stem cells for use in a clinical trial. Regen Ther 2024. DOI 10.1016/j.reth.2024.06.012

reported_equipment: dry shipper provided by the courier
digital data logger (Tempmate GmbH, Heilbronn, Germany)

requirements.rationale: Acceptance criterion: below -130 C throughout the transport.
The container must hold temperature without refill or power for the longest observed transit (178 h).
Transport is in the vapour phase of liquid nitrogen held in the dry shipper.
Shipper used was validated to keep -150 C or colder for 12 days (informative).

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
